names.note: Read out of the Охридски пролог’s fifth heading for 29. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Аполоније.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and not a rank and «муч.» is Мученик, the `martyr` grade, so both come off; the heading prints nothing else, and the senate, Rome and the year are all in the body. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN AND IT IS NOT FREE: the string already stands on `apollonius-the-reader`, who holds it as his own Serbian form, and the two-member fold it makes is declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this commit.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 29. новембар ст. ст.: «...због чега би посечен мачем, у Риму 186. год.» — beheaded with the sword at Rome in the year 186. It is the only year the entry gives and the only source read for him; there is no year of birth.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.12.2025 (29. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Аполоније.“

attestations.note: The day’s fifth and last entry, THREE SENTENCES: a Roman senator, accused for his faith in Christ, who confessed that faith before the whole Senate and was beheaded with the sword at Rome in 186. `types` is `martyr` alone, off «муч.»; senator is not a grade `types` keeps and it is in the display name instead. `dates` holds the one year the entry gives. No `locations`: Rome is named as the place of the beheading and not as a place he is fixed at for a bounded span, and BRIEF.md §4 prefers the field left out. No `related` row: the entry names nobody. WHY THIS IS A NEW FOLDER: the corpus holds NINE other folders of this name and not one of them is a senator, is at Rome, or carries the year 186 — `apollonius-23-july` and `apollonius-martyr-6-july` are bare Greek lines with no dates at all, `apollonius-companion-of-proclus` stands with Proclus on 14 February, `apollonius-of-brescia` is a bishop of the second century at Brescia on 7 July, `apollonius-of-sardis` is of Sardis on 10 July, `apollonius-of-the-twenty-four-martyrs` died in 301, `apollonius-the-anchorite` is a fourth-century hermit on 21 January, `apollonius-the-reader` is a reader of the company of Diocletian’s years with a floruit of 290 on 14 December, and `apollon-babichev` is a Russian new martyr of the twentieth century. A senator of Rome beheaded in 186 under Commodus matches none of them, and nothing read joins him to any.
